method: Mechanism-first comparison of all 100 across direct clinical access, overdose, mental-health, survivor, housing, legal/policy, nutrition and environmental/transport alternatives. No sector quota, fame criterion or donor endorsement; ranks are research-priority judgments, not CE ranks.

reviewIntervals.scope: Boston only; primary retrieval, identity/geo/donation screen of every record and comparison of all 100. No alpha or independent-review time.

comparisonCaveat: Comparative discovery judgments prioritize plausible marginal health mechanisms and research value, not proven effectiveness or endorsements.
